outcome: Risk factors for neonatal adrenal haemorrhage
Clinical presentations of neonatal adrenal haemorrhage
finding: Vaginal delivery, macrosomia, and fetal acidaemia are the most important risk factors for neonatal adrenal haemorrhage.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly more frequent than caesarean section among neonates with neonatal adrenal haemorrhage.
